Hello Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
ENGIE VIANEO
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P5 170000510
Charger ID/Serial No.:
E7UBEl
Problem Description:
DC2_StateMonitor_KF13
Before rebooting, there were several active error flags on the charger, and all the outlet 3 were out of order. After the reboot, all error flags disappeared, leaving zero active flags.
If the error persist then perform the below steps:
1.Access the Debug station
2.Check the current status of converters
3.Access SCB configuration
4.Compare values
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 08/08/2024, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
